newsitem.title: MEXICO: Promex, Banco Atlantico to form pension fund firm.
newsitem.headline: Promex, Banco Atlantico to form pension fund firm.

text.p: The president of Grupo Financiero Promex Finamex, Eduardo Carrillo, announced on Wednesday that Banca Promex and Banco del Atlantico would form a pension fund firm, or Afore.
The deal would seek to include the American International Group Inc and Bank of Boston Corp.

"We are forming a partnership with Banco del Atlantico... both institutions have applied to form a business partnership for Afores," he told reporters. "We are in talks with a foreign institution called AIG...and we are in talks at the same time with Bank of Boston to participate in this Afore."

Carrillo said that, if the four companies reach an agreement, Banca Promex and Banco del Atlantico would have a 25 percent stake each. AIG and Bank of Boston would hold the remaining 50 percent, but Carrillo did not say if their shares would be equal.
Carrillo said the parties were in the "last fine points of negotiation."
